caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with an ornate shield-shaped backrest featuring intricate scrollwork and a carved central medallion near the top. The chair has curved, open arms that connect gracefully to the seat. The seat itself is upholstered with a fabric that displays vertical green stripes of varying shades. The front legs of the chair are straight with slight curves, while the back legs are not visible due to the viewpoint. The entire chair is rendered in shades of brown for the wood, with highlights and shadows to suggest dimension, and is set against a plain beige background. There is a handwritten name "LAWRENCE PHILLIPS" in the lower right corner.
title: Armchair
